description: Do I need a visa, and how long must my passport be valid? Returns the FCDO 'Entry requirements' section for one country as headed plain-text subsections: passport validity, visas and length of stay, dual nationals, vaccine certificates and customs rules. Live from the GOV.UK Content API. Written for travellers on a full British citizen passport; other nationalities must check with the destination's embassy, and the destination's own authorities set and enforce the rules. (cost: 1 credit)

country.description: string, required, country name, alternative name (city, island) or GOV.UK slug, e.g. "spain"

name: travel_advice_entry_requirements
